name: Easy Moving Permits
description: Online platform to apply for and manage moving / street / dumpster / scaffolding parking permits across cities — transparent pricing including city fees + service charge; charged per application via Stripe.

mentions.evidence: ~$2.0k L30, MRR $0 / no active subscriptions (transaction model), ~$24.4k all-time, founded Nov 2025, US. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Government-process UX for one city → expand city-by-city; service fee on top of municipal fees.

whyItPrints: Civic permit glue. Movers and residents will pay to not get towed. Transaction model, not seats — same energy as MyCater's "take a cut of the inevitable spend."
